videos.title: 12 Dashboard design tips for better data visualization
videos.why: Twelve tool-agnostic tips, from knowing the dashboard's purpose and cutting non-data ink to rounding numbers and giving every figure context.

videos.title: EVERYTHING you need to know to build a Dashboard UI in 8 minutes (beginner friendly)
videos.why: The interface around the data, including sidebars, main layout, modals and popovers, and the handful of components most SaaS dashboards are built from.

podcasts.episode: storytelling with data: #24 Andy, Jeff & Steve and The Big Book of Dashboards
podcasts.why: The three authors of The Big Book of Dashboards on design tips and the aim of giving the most understanding for the least effort.

podcasts.episode: 7. Lessen Digital Misery with Complex Apps (feat. Page Laubheimer, Sr. UX Specialist at NN/g)
podcasts.why: How to keep business and enterprise tools simple when the work itself is complex, from an NN/g specialist in complex app design.

reads.title: Common Pitfalls in Dashboard Design
reads.why: Stephen Few's thirteen common dashboard mistakes, from spilling past a single screen to misusing colour; skip the vendor addendum at the end.

reads.title: Choosing Chart Types: Consider Context
reads.why: How to pick a chart by the question it must answer, and why bar, line and scatter charts cover most cases.

reads.title: Data Table Design UX Patterns & Best Practices
reads.why: Detailed, illustrated rules for data tables, covering alignment, headers, row density, sorting and filtering.
